note_history.10-Q.key_note_tags.from: the current 10-Q XBRL instance 10-Q/mu-20260528_htm.xml: every element whose local name ends in 'TextBlock' listed with ElementTree and a start-ns pass for the prefixes, importing nothing from src/, then each name read against the six key notes docs/INPUT_SPEC.md section 5 names — revenue_recognition_policy: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock, whose text opens 'Revenue and Customer Contract Liabilities', and us-gaap:DisaggregationOfRevenueTableTextBlock, its revenue-by-technology table (DRAM, NAND, 'Other (primarily NOR)'), as Dell's reading took the same pair; critical_accounting_estimates: us-gaap:BasisOfPresentationAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock, whose text opens 'Significant Accounting Policies For a discussion of our significant accounting policies, see Part II, Item 8', as Apple's and Logitech's readings took the same tag; debt: us-gaap:DebtDisclosureTextBlock (the note 'Debt', the Notes and Green Bonds the company owes), us-gaap:ScheduleOfDebtInstrumentsTextBlock (its carrying-amount table) and mu:ScheduleOfDebtActivityTableTextBlock, the company's own table inside that note, 'The table below presents the effects of debt prepayment activity in the first nine months of 2026', as Omnicell's and TTM's readings took their own tables inside the debt note; no contingencies, related-party or subsequent-events note is tagged as a TextBlock in either quarter. The contingencies note exists - Note 10, 'Contingencies' - but the instance carries it as us-gaap:LossContingencyDisclosures, a name that does not end in 'TextBlock', so the input spec's every-TextBlock rule does not reach it and it is not in this list. us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTableTextBlock is the available-for-sale investments the company holds ('All of our short-term investments and long-term marketable investments were classified as available for sale') and names no debt it owes, so it is not the debt note; us-gaap:BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock is the single policy paragraph 'The accompanying consolidated financial statements include the accounts of Micron Technology, Inc.', which none of the twelve's readings took as the critical-accounting-estimates note; us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityDisclosureTextBlock is the lease-financing special purpose entities, not a note about debt the company owes. This is where the reading DISAGREES with the parser: src/note_history.py's 'debt' pattern matches the bare substring 'debt' and pairs us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTableTextBlock, the investments table, as the debt note, so it lists 7 where this reading lists 6
